# Jubril Elebute

> Software engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria. Builds TypeScript, Next.js and PostgreSQL applications with authentication, role-based access and tests. Background in biochemistry (Lagos State University).

## Projects
- [Aláfíà](https://alafia-ara.vercel.app): community health platform connecting patients and clinics. Source: https://github.com/wrldcodes/alafia
- [MentorBridge](https://mentorbridge-pi.vercel.app): mentorship platform with role-based dashboards and session booking. Source: https://github.com/wrldcodes/MentorBridge
